# All In One Bail Bonds

> 24-hour bail bond agency in North Carolina with offices in Raleigh, Durham and Wilson. Licensed NC bail agents post secured appearance bonds at county jails statewide. Main phone (919) 247-9397.

## Key facts
- Phone (24/7): (919) 247-9397. Email: allinonebailbonds@gmail.com.
- Bail agent: Zakee Bodhi Cromartie, North Carolina licensed bail agent.
- Hours: Open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, including holidays.
- Cost: in North Carolina the bail bond premium cannot exceed 15% of the bond amount (N.C. Gen. Stat. 58-71-95). The premium is the fee for the service and is not refunded when the case ends.
- Payment: we accept some payment arrangements; any deferred payment is put in a signed written agreement, as NC law requires.
- Google reviews as of November 19, 2026: Raleigh 5.0 stars (295 reviews); Durham 5.0 stars (156 reviews); Wilson 5.0 stars (43 reviews).
- Not a law firm; does not give legal advice or recommend attorneys. Not affiliated with any court, jail or government agency.

## Offices
- Raleigh: 6104 Westgate Road, Suite 110, Raleigh, NC 27617. Phone (919) 247-9397.
- Durham: 3326 Guess Road, Suite 201, Durham, NC 27705. Phone (919) 247-9397.
- Wilson: 2509 Nash Street N, Suite B9, Wilson, NC 27896. Phone (252) 373-0538.
